purpose: Construct a response-blind pairwise predictor of shared LGM suitable geography for the Palearctic-core Lepidoptera panel, then qualify that predictor with TTF-Q before any subpanel genetic response is computed.

ecological_occurrences.source: GBIF occurrence records independent of the genetic response
ecological_occurrences.failure: species is predictor-inadmissible; do not replace it based on any genetic quantity

climate.standardization: fit from present-day Palearctic-core land cells and reuse unchanged for LGM projection

sdm.features: standardized linear and quadratic terms for the four frozen climate variables; no post-response feature search
sdm.background: deterministic sample of Palearctic-core non-NA CHELSA land cells inside a 500-km buffer of the species occurrence convex hull
sdm.regularization: single frozen ridge penalty selected before genetic response; no species-specific tuning from genetic outcomes
sdm.response_blind_quality_check: spatially blocked occurrence-vs-background discrimination and non-degenerate LGM projection; failures remove only predictor-inadmissible species before TTF-Q

pairwise_primary_relation.name: R_LGM
pairwise_primary_relation.definition: Schoener D between source and target LGM suitability rasters after each raster is normalized to sum to one on the shared Palearctic-core grid
pairwise_primary_relation.directionality: symmetric predictor copied onto both source->target directions because the later genetic cross-prediction response is directed

declared_controls: present-day SDM Schoener D on the same grid
directed present geographic co-opportunity at 500 km

ttf_q_gate.output: full evaluable envelope; never a one-cell PASS/FAIL substitute
ttf_q_gate.if_not_evaluable: STOP; do not construct or inspect the Palearctic subpanel genetic response
ttf_q_gate.if_evaluable: authorize one frozen subpanel genetic-response construction and analysis

future_genetic_question_if_authorized: Do source-target Lepidoptera pairs with more similar LGM suitable geography show stronger transfer/concordance of post-IBD spatial genetic differentiation?

response_firewall.claim_status: fresh response-blind re-analysis design, not an independent untouched confirmatory dataset
